steps.title: Sketch the flange circle
steps.command: 3D Model tab > Sketch panel > Start 2D Sketch
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt to start a new part.
Start 2D Sketch on the XZ Plane (the top).
Sketch tab > Create panel > Circle (Center Point): click the origin and drag out a circle.
Add the dimensions with Dimension (Sketch tab > Constrain panel): diameter 70. Click Finish Sketch.

steps.title: Extrude the flange
actions: Click Extrude. Distance A: 10 mm, upwards. Click OK.

steps.title: Sketch the body circle
steps.command: 3D Model tab > Sketch panel > Start 2D Sketch
actions: Start 2D Sketch and click the top face of the flange.
Circle (Center Point) on the projected centre point.
Add the dimensions with Dimension (Sketch tab > Constrain panel): diameter 40. Click Finish Sketch.

steps.title: Extrude the body
actions: Click Extrude. Distance A: 40 mm, upwards. Boolean: Join. Click OK.

steps.title: Bore the 24 mm hole
actions: Click Hole and click the top face of the body.
Click the circular edge to make the hole concentric.
Simple Hole. Diameter 24 mm. Termination: Through All. Click OK.

steps.title: Drill one bolt hole
actions: Click Hole and click the top face of the flange.
Place the centre on a 55 mm pitch circle (27.5 from the centre) at 45 degrees.
Simple Hole. Diameter 8 mm. Termination: Through All. Click OK.

steps.title: Pattern the bolt holes
steps.command: 3D Model tab > Pattern panel > Circular Pattern
actions: Click Circular Pattern. Features: pick the 8 mm hole in the browser.
Rotation Axis: pick the outside face of the body (its axis is used).
Placement: 4 occurrences over 360 degrees. Click OK.

steps.title: Chamfer the bore
actions: Click Chamfer. Method: Distance. Distance 1 mm.
Pick the top edge of the 24 mm bore. Click OK.
